name: Truth And Self Esteem
overview: Scripture reveals that human worth is rooted in being made in God's image, granting us a unique dignity and responsibility over creation (Genesis 1:26). Our true value is ultimately secured through God's love demonstrated in the gift of His Son, offering eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16; Romans 6:23). At the same time, believers are called to maintain a humble and sober view of themselves, recognizing that self-esteem should be measured by God's grace and the faith He has given, rather than by pride or arrogance (Romans 12:3).
